items.name: aura-card
items.title: Aura Card
items.description: Cursor-aware card with a light-catching glow. Calm by default, alive on hover.

items.name: sequence-scroll
items.title: Sequence Scroll
items.description: A pinned narrative section that scrubs through its steps as you scroll, then releases cleanly. GSAP ScrollTrigger under the hood.

items.name: lumen-hero
items.title: Lumen Hero
items.description: Full-bleed shader hero — a flowing iridescent light field in the pearl family, with the headline in the DOM for a11y and SEO.

items.name: polaroid-parallax
items.title: Polaroid Parallax
items.description: A scatter of photo prints that drift with the pointer, each at its own rate, so the frame gains depth.

items.name: magnetic-elements
items.title: Magnetic Elements
items.description: A wrapper that pulls opted-in children toward the pointer — the small physical tell of a considered interface.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Elements lift and sharpen as they scroll into view — the entrance every site rebuilds by hand.

items.name: tally-tiles
items.title: Tally Tiles
items.description: A row of figures that count up as they scroll into view, with the number carrying all the weight.

items.name: drift-marquee
items.title: Drift Marquee
items.description: Rows of tiles drifting in opposite directions — the river pattern, with no animation library.

items.name: beam-border
items.title: Beam Border
items.description: A lit segment travelling around the border of whatever you wrap — no library, no JavaScript in the loop.
